VBO:0201047.summary: Friendly and a joy to have around in his keeper’s account, sixteen-month-old Bug was a Poochon, a Bichon Frise–Poodle cross. Ten-year-old Pete’s owner described a loving dog who could be calm or joyfully playful. Pete rang sleigh bells on a doorknob to ask to go outside and used three barks to announce visitors.
VBO:0201047.shortDescription: Poochon keepers describe Bug’s friendliness and Pete’s playful affection, bell signal for going outside and visitor barks.
